name: Village izba with entrance hall
description: A wooden house with a living room, kitchen, bedroom, entrance hall, pantry, porch, and cellar. Gabled roof.

name: Rural house with veranda
description: A house with a wooden side veranda and projecting porch; the kitchen, bedroom, and living room form a separate residential volume.

name: Two-story village house
description: Four apartments per floor around central stairs; separate entrance halls, kitchens, bedrooms, and bathrooms. Eight apartments in total.

name: Five-story brick apartment block
description: Two independent entrances, four two-room apartments per landing, regular windows, and balconies. An original adaptation of a sectional brick apartment building.

name: Five-story panel apartment block
description: Two independent entrances, compact studio apartments with entrance halls, gray facades, balconies, and a flat roof. An alternative section layout.

name: Nine-story panel apartment tower
description: One stair core, four apartments per floor, a utility room, balconies, and a flat roof. The elevator is not modeled.

name: Rural barn with canopy
description: A utility building with a grain hall, pantry, workshop, and open area under a canopy. An original layout inspired by Russian wooden farm buildings.

name: Rural garage and workshop
description: A small annex with a spacious workshop, storage room, and office. Shed roof and a separate entrance.

name: Village shop
description: A sales floor, office, pantry, rear storage room, and bathroom. One floor; the shop layout was designed for the game without copying a standard plan.

name: Two-story village school
description: Two floors with four classrooms, a staff room, bathrooms, and utility rooms around a central corridor and stairs. An original adaptation of a public building.

name: Three-story brick apartment block
description: A compact building with two spacious apartments per floor and central stairs. Brick walls and a pitched roof inspired by mid-20th-century urban housing.

name: L-shaped urban house
description: Four floors, three apartments per level, and a shared stair core. Two wings form a courtyard; an original adaptation of a corner brick building.

name: Northern longhouse
description: A wooden house with a long entrance hall connecting the living area, kitchen, and utility storage under a shared gabled roof.

name: Brick cottage with attic floor
description: Two residential levels: living room, kitchen, and study downstairs; three bedrooms and a bathroom upstairs. Stairs in a separate hall.

name: House with utility wing
description: A living area, entrance hall, and separate utility wing form a stepped outline and an open terrace.

name: Village bathhouse
description: A changing room, washing room, utility room, and entrance vestibule. A compact wooden building with a hipped roof.

name: Village duplex
description: Two fully independent apartments, each with its own entrance, stairs, and upstairs bedrooms.

name: Village terraced housing
description: Four independent two-story sections with separate entrances, kitchens, and internal stairs.

name: Village clinic
description: Two levels: reception and offices along a shared corridor; staff rooms and patient wards upstairs.

name: Village courtyard house
description: Two residential wings around an open courtyard; a shared corridor and stairs beside the gate.

name: Compact six-story apartment block
description: Two apartments per floor, a shared stair hall, and separate kitchens, bedrooms, and bathrooms. Six levels and a flat roof.

name: Urban courtyard apartment block
description: Four levels in an enclosed block with an open courtyard, a through corridor, apartments in the side wings, and two staircases.

name: Urban apartments above shops
description: A spacious ground-floor shop with two smaller residential levels above it. Utility rooms and stairs are separate from the sales floor.

name: Urban townhouse row
description: Three independent three-story blocks with separate entrances; living rooms, kitchens, and bedrooms are distributed across the levels.
